content.text: {"headline":"Approve P1: a no-cost tweak that lifts general to 91.0% and keeps the day on target (92.8% vs 80% goal)","why":"General calls have run 26–51% above forecast since 10:15 (855 vs 623 expected over the last 2 hours), spread evenly across call reasons, with no incident or campaign to explain it. Staffing and absence are not the issue. Even with no action, the disruption window (12:30–20:00) is predicted at 92.7%, well above the 80% target, so heavy spending isn't needed. P1 is the cheapest plan that follows policy and reaches the target. It costs nothing: it delays the 13:00–13:30 general breaks by 30 minutes and moves 2 cross-skilled agents from payments to general from 19:00 to 20:00. General improves from 89.2% to 91.0% and abandons fall from 1.7% to 1.5%.","trade_offs":["Payments gives up some headroom: it drops from 96.0% to 94.5% because of the evening moves, still comfortably above target.","P2 (₹1,440 overtime) and P4 (₹900, chat deflection plus overtime) lift the overall level to about 94% and keep payments at 96.7%, but general only reaches 91.5% and 91.2%.","P3 (₹2,340) is the strongest at 94.5% overall, 92.7% general and 1.2% abandons, but it costs the most for a small gain over a plan that already meets target.","Delayed breaks push agent breaks back by 30 minutes, a minor wellbeing cost."],"watch":"The cause of the surge is unknown, so check that general volume isn't climbing further. If general falls toward 80%, or payments slips after the 19:00 moves, step up to P4 (₹900) as the next cheapest option."}
